label: accepted
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read instantly as a sword (pointed blade, recurved ball-tipped guard, disc pommel); silhouette render is clean. Top view shrinks to a small guard bar with a blade lozenge, which is weak but normal for a sword.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: the long blade is the big form, guard, grip and pommel are the medium forms, and the gem, grip bands, fuller and raised guard boss are small detail.
evidence.V3: Chunky gold guard and pommel are stylised, but the blade is a slim, straight, near-realistic strip and the grip looks spindly between the heavy fittings, so the exaggeration is only partial.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers catch light on the guard top edge, raised boss, pommel rims and blade edge strips; ball tips and gem are clean by design.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean (A18 pass, 0 flipped, 0 self-intersections), but the pommel close-up shows a visibly polygonal rim on the dome and collar (low segment count), and the tip close-up shows a slight angle break where the straight edge turns into the point taper.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent, two steel greys plus a dark slate fuller, and a single teal hue on the grip and gem. Colourways swap only the hue (crimson, violet) and keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 2476 tris against the weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000), so it is at target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours; the palette matches the kit (gold, steel greys, one hue); chamfers and smooth shading are consistent with the kit spec.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Tool Handle, origin at the grip point, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pommel dome and collar ring show a faceted, polygonal outline in close-up (pommel_studio): the cylinder segment count is too low for the smooth-shaded kit
Blade tip: slight angular kink where the parallel edges start tapering to the point (tip_studio, left edge)
Minor: dark contact line between the pommel collar and the dome top. It is probably a shadow, but the pommel is not in the gate's seats list, so the seating is unverified
top_fixes: Raise segment count on the pommel dome and collar (and grip rings if they share it) so their rims read round in close-up
Push stylised proportion: widen the blade (and broaden the tip ogive) and thicken the grip slightly so they match the chunky guard and pommel
Smooth the transition from the straight blade edge into the tip taper (add a loop or blend the curve) to remove the visible kink
Add pommel_on_grip / collar_on_pommel to the seating check so the pommel junction is verified rather than assumed
